scope: Independent algorithm candidate correcting repeated-rounding error; preserve baseline and all frozen R001-R006 evidence. Numerical fidelity only; no task ACC/PPL rerun.
hypothesis: Repeated directed right-shift truncation can introduce bias that propagates across decoder layers. Evaluate implementable integer rounding changes rather than modifying final reported tensors.

same ScaleCode, Hadamard and format05 interfaces
same final output widths and host transforms
each arm recomputes its dynamic activation and KV codes
no changes to frozen consumed sources

Any added guard bits must be separately identified with hardware costs and not conflated with equal-width correction.

Dataset remains development/validation, not held-out formal 1024 proof. Freeze exact IDs and candidate roster before inference.
metrics: per-document layer32 pre-final-norm relative L2 percent
per-position softmax total variation at temperature 1
